critique_titles: botbrain.js still uses hitscan traceShot while players fire slow projectiles

one_big_idea: Bots fire real dodgeable projectiles with lead prediction; eliminations become a 6s Bubble Float respawn

directives.title: Bots fire real projectiles
directives.acceptance: No WEAPON/traceShot import in botbrain.js; every bot shot is a visible object; strafing dodges >60% of shots

directives.title: Bubble Float respawn
directives.acceptance: Max 6s out of control in tactical; 1.5s invuln on respawn; One Life condition still ends the round

directives.title: Retire the carbine, tighten hit validation
directives.acceptance: grep for WEAPON|Magazine|applySpread returns nothing; per-tool range validation server-side

challenge_for_mikel: Is Bla Keks World about WHO YOU PICKED or WHAT YOU FOUND? The code votes 'what you found' (rarity rolls, random secondary, item field) while the README pitches a class-fantasy PvP. Pick one: kill RARITY and ship four named classes (Splasher / Bubbler / Petal / Blade), or make rarity visible, earned and tradeable. You can't have both.
